Project_Details.SOW_Duration: XXXXX months (including XXXXX months of warranty)

2.0 Executive Summary.Objective: [Client] intends to transition the [Legacy Environment] Teradata environment to BigQuery on Google Cloud, enabling a more scalable and cost-efficient data platform.
Scope_Overview: All workloads and end-to-end pipelines for identified datasets will be migrated to GCP.
Move groups will be identified based on dataset lineage dependencies.
Migrate Archive/Cold Storage/Legal hold from legacy online and Tape to GCP.
Switchover the views from previous phases to point to the direct sourced tables.

a. Consumption Replication.i. Table and View Copy: Copy identified consumption tables and views from Teradata to GCP BigQuery.
a. Consumption Replication.ii. Schema Structure: Leverage existing Teradata data models to create the same schema structure for the BigQuery consumption layer.

b. Continuous Sync Pipelines.i. Pipeline Development: Develop data pipeline for continuous data sync from Teradata.
b. Continuous Sync Pipelines.ii. Incremental Population: Incremental data through a continuous sync pipeline to populate the consumption layer.
b. Continuous Sync Pipelines.iii. Solution Patterns: Establish solution patterns to refresh on the BigQuery target tables (refresh frequency finalized during discovery).

c. Testing and Validation.ii. Production Grade Testing: Test schemas with production-grade data in UAT and deploy to production.
c. Testing and Validation.iv. Automated Validation: Data Validation between legacy and GCP using [Vendor] IP Validation Tool.
c. Testing and Validation.v. Validation Standard: XXXXX consecutive full validation runs and thereafter count match.

a. Historical Data Migration.i. Extraction: [Vendor] will use historical data pipelines available from [Client] to extract data from Teradata Source Schema to new BigQuery model.
a. Historical Data Migration.ii. UAT Loading: Load historical data (production grade) in UAT environment from GCS to BigQuery for testing.
a. Historical Data Migration.iii. Production Loading: Load production historical data from GCS bucket to BigQuery working with [Client] production support team.

b. Incremental Data Pipelines.i. Pipeline Setup: Set Up Incremental Data Movement and Pipelines.
b. Incremental Data Pipelines.ii. Framework Compliance: Follow [Client] set [Internal Framework] processes to bring data into GCP.
b. Incremental Data Pipelines.iii. Security Integration: Data tokenization and encryption solutions will be integral part of [Internal Framework] and leveraged in the pipeline.
b. Incremental Data Pipelines.iv. Component Testing: Perform current sprint components testing with upgraded version of software (AbInitio/[Internal Framework]/Teradata).

c. Code Conversion.i. Logic Equivalence: Conversion of Teradata code pipeline to functionally equivalent code pipeline on BigQuery.
c. Code Conversion.ii. DDL Conversion: Conversion of Teradata tables and views DDLs to equivalent BigQuery objects.
c. Code Conversion.iii. Native Script Conversion: Conversion of Teradata native scripts (SQL, Stored Procedures, Bteqs, Macros) to GCP native.
c. Code Conversion.iv. Quality Assurance: Conversion process will not result in loss of existing business functionality or data.
c. Code Conversion.v. Catalog Setup: Data Catalog setup for tables and fields adhering to [Internal Framework] solutions.
c. Code Conversion.vi. Integration Limits: Changes to ETL tools are limited to forking data into the future state GCP.

d. Orchestration and Scheduling.ii. Workflow Scheduling: Compose and schedule cloud workflow through DAGs wrapping translated BigQuery SQLs.

i. Unit Testing: 2. Create test scripts to ensure features work with test data.
3. Bug identification, tracking, definition, and priority setup.

f. User Acceptance Testing (UAT).i. System Testing: Conduct system testing in QA/UAT with production-grade data provided by [Client].
f. User Acceptance Testing (UAT).ii. Pre-Validation Runs: Run incremental pipelines on Teradata and BigQuery before automated validation.
f. User Acceptance Testing (UAT).iii. Success Criteria: XXXXX parallel runs/data validation reports for historical and incremental load.

g. Production Release.i. Deployment Support: Provide build and release for production deployment and support issues.
g. Production Release.ii. Framework Adoption: Adopt existing CI/CD framework to deploy code to production.
g. Production Release.iii. Governance: Submit Change requests, upload templates/documents, and follow up for approvals.

h. Production Parallel Period.i. Validation Reports: Generate Data validation reports on production for historical and incremental data.
h. Production Parallel Period.ii. Post-Signoff Support: Provide bug fixes during parallel run period within agreed SLA per severity.

i. Documentation and Handover.ii. Knowledge Transfer: Conduct XXXXX sessions of XXXXX hour each iteratively for each move group.
i. Documentation and Handover.iv. Technical Specs: Update technical specification documents to add GCP-specific details.

j. Warranty.i. Duration: XXXXX months of warranty covering data pipeline failures, mismatch, and orchestration failures.
j. Warranty.ii. Monitoring: [Vendor] monitors first XXXXX runs; [Client] monitors from XXXXX run onwards.

k. ETL Complexity and Mapping.i. Job Complexity Breakdown: Total ETL jobs will be categorized into Simple (1-1 mapping), Medium (standard joins/filters), and Complex (aggregations and custom logic) to define effort.
k. ETL Complexity and Mapping.ii. STTM Ownership: [Client] SMEs will provide business rules; [Vendor] will document the Source-to-Target Mapping (STTM); [Client] formal sign-off is required prior to development.

l. Operational Framework.i. Error Handling & Alerting: Design and implement a centralized error handling, exception logging, and alerting framework within GCP Cloud Composer.
